Reads a completed run directory and re-expresses its captures under this contract's field names. It decides nothing: the only computed value buckets an observed status code into its class, and a field the run failed to capture is omitted and listed in incomplete_fields so the evaluator answers INCONCLUSIVE rather than reading a fabricated zero as a refutation.

known_gaps: The two contract systems are bridged rather than merged. run.py still fixes and evaluates contract.json, and scripts/golden/collect_scenario_a.py re-expresses the same run directory under the names this manifest declares, so both can be evaluated from one execution without a second deployment. Merging them remains outstanding.

Two trust vocabularies coexist. This file uses trusted-current, trusted-historical, unverified and invalid, describing custody of an artifact, while evidence.schema.json uses primary, derived and reported, describing how an observation was obtained. They answer different questions and are not yet reconciled.
